rules.title: FFmpeg swscale hint
rules.body: This class of bugs often triggers via **ffmpeg** with **rawvideo** input (e.g. `yuva444p16le`), a **large scale** filter (`scale=8192:8192:flags=lanczos+...`), and output `ya16le`. The PoC is typically a small raw planar frame file, not a container.

rules.title: FFmpeg demuxer hint
rules.body: JPEG XL animation bugs often need **ffprobe** or **ffmpeg** with `-f jpegxl_anim` and an oversized/sparse `.jxl` input.

rules.title: FFmpeg sbgdec hint
rules.body: SBG demuxer bugs often use **ffmpeg** with `-f sbg` and a crafted text/script input.

rules.title: FFmpeg AV1 hint
rules.body: Minimal **IVF-wrapped AV1** bitstream: `error_resilient_mode=1` infers `primary_ref_frame=7`, combined with `is_global[LAST_FRAME]=1` and translation model to hit `read_global_param()`. Use `ffprobe -f ivf` or `ffmpeg -i @@ -f null -`.

rules.title: FFmpeg CENC/MOV hint
rules.body: Craft **cbc1/cenc** MP4 with subsample fields summing to 2^32 (`bytes_of_clear_data` + `bytes_of_protected_data` wraps to 0). Run: `ffprobe -decryption_key 00000000000000000000000000000000 -show_packets @@`.

rules.title: FFmpeg DVD subtitle hint
rules.body: Requires a **~2 GB sparse MPEG-PS** with many DVD-subtitle PES packets (`packet_len` near INT_MAX, then overflow on `packet_index + buf_size`). Use `ffprobe -show_packets @@` and `exec_timeout_sec` >= 600.
